name: Sakha (Yakut-Sakha SSR, 1990–1992)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Якутская-Саха ССР' in yellow.
history: The RSFSR-pattern flag of the Yakut ASSR with the inscription changed after the sovereignty declaration of September 1990 renamed the republic the Yakut-Sakha SSR. It was replaced on 14 October 1992 by the present flag with the white sun.
